Maria Torres
Projects Process About

Architecture & Design

I create thoughtful, human-centered spaces that balance form, function, and sustainability. Based in Barcelona, working worldwide.

Selected Projects

A curated selection of residential, commercial, and cultural projects completed over the past decade.

Casa del Mar

A minimalist coastal residence in Mallorca featuring floor-to-ceiling glass walls and natural stone finishes.

The Lumen Pavilion

A cultural exhibition space designed around natural light, with a retractable roof and modular interior walls.

Vertex Office Tower

A 12-story commercial tower in Madrid featuring a biophilic design approach with integrated green terraces.

Garden House

A private residence built around an interior courtyard garden, blending indoor and outdoor living spaces seamlessly.

Museo de Arte Nuevo

A contemporary art museum with cantilevered gallery spaces and a sculptural concrete façade inspired by Brutalism.

Sierra Retreat

A mountain retreat using locally sourced timber and rammed earth, designed for off-grid sustainable living.

Design Process

Every project follows a collaborative, iterative process from concept to completion.

Discovery & Research

Understanding the site, context, and client vision through in-depth research and site analysis.

Concept Development

Exploring spatial ideas through sketches, models, and diagrams to shape the architectural narrative.

Technical Design

Translating concepts into detailed drawings, material specifications, and construction documents.

Construction & Delivery

Overseeing construction with precision to ensure the built result matches the design intent.

Areas of Expertise

Specialized in multiple disciplines across architecture and spatial design.

Specializations

Select a discipline to learn more about my experience and approach in each area.

Let's Build Something Together

I'm currently accepting new projects. Reach out to discuss your vision and how we can bring it to life.
